picks.excerpt: Apple explains how the iPhone 18 Pro’s new Reference Image camera mode works - 9to5Mac. A new post on Apple’s Security Research blog details the fascinating tech, architecture, and thinking behind the iPhone 18 Pro’s new Reference Image camera mode.
picks.rationale: Apple publishing the architecture behind a provenance-guaranteed camera mode is the clearest spec yet for how an authenticated image gets made in an AI-generated world.

picks.excerpt: Perplexity’s local AI agent comes to Windows, but only for RTX GPUs with at least 24GB of VRAM — Portable Computer brings AI for multistep tasks to compatible PCs. Portable Computer arrives on Windows RTX PCs

picks.excerpt: Microsoft is finally letting Windows 11 users take back the keyboard keys Copilot stole. You'll soon be able to remap the Copilot key to either Right Ctrl or the Context Menu.
picks.rationale: Microsoft reversing a hardware-level AI shortcut is a rare admission that dedicated AI keys are an input-design decision users should own, not a fixture.
